cobra.area: Normandy, Cobra support mission in the St-Lô area

references.detail: 483 Eighth Air Force escorts; 12 claimed destroyed in the air. One probable, three damaged and two ground claims are separate.
Original Eighth Air Force mission report, archival catalogue entry.
German calendar reports 10 own aircraft lost in its wider area. The daily summary covers day and night activity and leaves the cause and Allied attribution of those losses open.
German situation report estimates about 2,500 US and 1,400 British fighter and fighter-bomber sorties, with attacks concentrated around Caen and St-Lô.
The USAAF official history records four aircraft claimed destroyed by Ninth Air Force's 406th Group over Lisieux on the same day.
